name: Dialog
description:
A modal dialog built from parts: `Root` (state; a bottom sheet on phones by default),
`Trigger`, `Popup`, `Header`, `Body` (scrolls), `Footer`, `Title`, `Description` and
`Close`. `Preview` renders the same parts statically for documentation.

props.name: actionsRef
props.type: RefObject<{ unmount: () => void; close: () => void; } | null> | undefined
props.description: Ref exposing the component’s imperative action contract.

props.name: children
props.description: The content or component slots rendered inside the component.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Opens the uncontrolled overlay initially.

props.name: disablePointerDismissal
props.description: Keep the dialog open on outside press (Esc still closes).

props.name: modal
props.description: Default true. `false` lets the page stay interactive (rare; prefer a Popover or Sheet).

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Called with the next open state and Base UI change details (the reason; `details.cancel()` keeps it open) when the trigger, Esc, an outside press, a close control or a sheet swipe opens or dismisses it. Pair with `open` to control it.

props.name: onOpenChangeComplete
props.description: Called with the final open state once the open or close animation has finished.

props.name: open
props.description: Controls whether the overlay is open.

props.name: sheet
props.description:
`auto` (default) renders a bottom sheet with a grab handle on phones (< 48rem) and a
centred dialog elsewhere (R13.4). Force either with true/false.

props.name: children
props.description: The content or component slots rendered inside the component.

props.name: className
props.description:
CSS class applied to the element, or a function that
returns a class based on the component's state.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables interaction while retaining the component’s disabled appearance.

props.name: handle
props.description:
A handle to associate the trigger with a dialog.
Can be created with the Dialog.createHandle() method.

props.name: id
props.description:
ID of the trigger. In addition to being forwarded to the rendered element,
it is also used to specify the active trigger for the dialog in controlled mode (with the DialogRoot `triggerId` prop).

props.name: name
props.description: The component’s name or native form field name, as specified by its value type.

props.name: nativeButton
props.description:
Whether the component renders a native `<button>` element when replacing it
via the `render` prop.
Set to `false` if the rendered element is not a button (for example, `<div>`).

props.name: payload
props.description: A payload to pass to the dialog when it is opened.

props.name: ref
props.type: ((((instance: HTMLButtonElement | null) => void | (() => VoidOrUndefinedOnly) | DO_NOT_USE_OR_YOU_WILL_BE_FIRED_CALLBACK_REF_RETURN_VALUES[keyof DO_NOT_USE_OR_YOU_WILL_BE_FIRED_CALLBACK_REF_RETURN_VALUES]) | RefObject<HTMLButtonElement | null>) & (((instance: HTMLElement | null) => void | (() => VoidOrUndefinedOnly) | DO_NOT_USE_OR_YOU_WILL_BE_FIRED_CALLBACK_REF_RETURN_VALUES[keyof DO_NOT_USE_OR_YOU_WILL_BE_FIRED_CALLBACK_REF_RETURN_VALUES]) | RefObject<HTMLElement | null>)) | null | undefined
props.description:
Allows getting a ref to the component instance.
Once the component unmounts, React will set `ref.current` to `null`
(or call the ref with `null` if you passed a callback ref).

props.name: render
props.description:
Allows you to replace the component's HTML element
with a different tag, or compose it with another component.

Accepts a `ReactElement` or a function that returns the element to render.

props.name: style
props.description:
Style applied to the element, or a function that
returns a style object based on the component's state.

props.name: value
props.description: The controlled value. Keep it in application state and update it in the change callback.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible name when a visible label does not name the control.

props.name: children
props.description: The content or component slots rendered inside the component.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes applied to the outer element for layout. Use the component props and theme tokens for its appearance.

props.name: finalFocus
props.type: boolean | RefObject<HTMLElement | null> | ((closeType: import("@base-ui/utils/useEnhancedClickHandler").InteractionType) => boolean | HTMLElement | null | void) | undefined
props.description: The element or behaviour to focus when the overlay closes.

props.name: initialFocus
props.type: boolean | RefObject<HTMLElement | null> | ((openType: import("@base-ui/utils/useEnhancedClickHandler").InteractionType) => boolean | HTMLElement | null | void) | undefined
props.description: The element or behaviour to focus when the overlay opens. By default a keyboard open focuses the first control outside the header close button (or the popup), and a touch open focuses the popup.

props.name: kind
props.description: `settings` fixes the height so switching sections never resizes the dialog.

props.name: size
props.description: sm 400 · md 560 · lg 760 · xl 1040 · full. Ignored by phone sheets (full width).

props.description: The heading or title content.
